name: Heading Light
description: A bar of light that opens above a heading and throws a soft cone down onto it.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the light. At night the bar has a snow-white core and the cone glows; by day the bar is a water line and the cone a pale wash.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the bar once open, as any CSS length. It opens from half this width.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds between entering the view and opening.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the bar takes to open.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, a relative flex column that centres the light and the content horizontally and clips the cone. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content placed under the bar, in the pool of light. It rises a few pixels as the light opens.
